item.title: SCF #45 Round Recap
item.content:encoded:
Cara7 — $127,900 worth of XLM*
Institutional infrastructure for tokenizing auto-loan receivableson Stellar, with a configurable Soroban payment-waterfall contract, EURC distributions via the Stellar Asset Contract, MPC custody and fiat ramp integration, and issuer/investor dashboards.

Pollar — $89,500 worth of XLM*
An SDK giving Stellar apps embedded wallets and USDC charging via Google or email login, plus a unified fiat on/off-ramp API across seven anchors in six Latin American countries, with webhooks, reconciliation, and KYC tiers.

Minisend — $100,000 worth of XLM*
A Stellar anchor and settlement rail letting users send USDC and receive local currency via M-Pesa, Airtel Money, or bank in Africa, using SEP standards and Circle CCTP liquidity.

item.title: SCF #44 Round Recap
item.content:encoded:
Lusty Finance — $82,500 worth of XLM*
Lusty is a protocol on Stellar that enables options strategies such as covered calls and cash-secured puts on XLMa protocol on Stellar that enables options strategies such as covered calls and cash-secured puts on XLM.

VERSO — Peru’s First Regulated Stellar Anchor — $110,000 worth of XLM* VERSO is a regulated stablecoin exchange operating in Peru since 2022 that will build the country’s first regulated Stellar Anchor, connecting the Stellar ecosystem with Peru’s banking infrastructure.
